overview.zh: 黑客攻击与安全漏洞主导今日加密市场，Liquid Network遭3.2亿美元盗窃，Cronos回滚逆转1.11亿美元攻击，量子抗性期限设定引发关注。 Liquid Network攻击：Liquid Network遭攻击，约4000 BTC被盗，其中3400 BTC已归还，仍有约600 BTC未追回。 Cronos回滚：Cronos验证者回滚10961个区块，逆转Tectonic攻击中约1.112亿美元损失，但919万美元已转出网络。 量子抗性期限：以太坊基金会设定2029年12月为量子抗性截止日期，计划每7.2个月进行一次硬分叉以实现目标。
overview.en: Hacks and security vulnerabilities dominate today's crypto market, with Liquid Network losing $320M, Cronos rollback reversing $111M exploit, and quantum resistance deadline set. Liquid Network exploit：Liquid Network lost ~4,000 BTC, with 3,400 BTC returned and ~600 BTC still outstanding. Cronos rollback：Cronos validators rolled back 10,961 blocks to reverse ~$111.2M from Tectonic exploit, but $9.19M left the network. Quantum deadline：Ethereum Foundation set December 2029 as non-negotiable quantum-resistance deadline, requiring hard forks every ~7.2 months.

title.zh: 黑客窃取 Liquid Network 3.2 亿美元比特币，补丁后归还大部分
title.en: Liquid Network hackers steal $320M in Bitcoin, return most after patch

summary.zh:
攻击者利用 Liquid Network 的 Elements 软件漏洞铸造了无锚定的 L-BTC，并从其储备中盗走约 4,000 BTC（约 3.2 亿美元）。约 3,400 BTC 已于 9 月 7 日归还，Blockstream 正在就追回剩余约 600 BTC 进行谈判；周一对桥接节点部署了补丁，并准备发布紧急更新。

这是涉及比特币侧链的最大规模攻击事件之一，直接检验用户对联合锚定和封装比特币产品的信任。它表明即使没有私钥泄露或节点被入侵，交易验证漏洞仍可能危及用户资金。

Liquid 的储备在暂停运营前从约 4,205 BTC 降至 197 BTC；Liquid 表示 USDT 和其他 Liquid 发行的资产未受漏洞影响，但暂停期间用户无法交易。验证失败发生在提现（peg-out）启动之前的交易层面，导致 SideSwap 节点和 Liquid 分布式 functionary 节点都接受了无锚定的 L-BTC，目前仍有约 600 BTC（约 4,700 万美元）尚未归还。
summary.en:
Attackers exploited a vulnerability in Liquid Network's Elements software to mint unbacked L-BTC and drained roughly 4,000 BTC (~$320 million) from its reserve. About 3,400 BTC were returned on Sept. 7, and Blockstream is negotiating to recover the remaining ~600 BTC after patching bridge nodes and preparing an emergency update.

This is one of the largest exploits involving a Bitcoin sidechain and directly tests how much trust users place in federated pegs and wrapped Bitcoin products. It shows that transaction-validation failures can jeopardize user funds even when no private keys or federation nodes are compromised.

Liquid's reserve fell from about 4,205 BTC to 197 BTC before operations were halted; Liquid said USDT and other Liquid-issued tokens were unaffected by the vulnerability, though users could not transact during the pause. The validation failure occurred at the transaction level before the peg-out was initiated, so SideSwap's node and Liquid's distributed functionary nodes accepted the unbacked L-BTC, and roughly 600 BTC (~$47 million) remains outstanding.

title.zh: Cronos 回滚抹去两小时交易，逆转 Tectonic 1.11 亿美元攻击
title.en: Cronos Rollback Reverses $111M Tectonic Exploit, Erases Two Hours of Transactions

summary.zh:
Cronos 的验证者暂停了网络并回滚了 10,961 个区块，丢弃了 1 小时 54 分钟的交易，以逆转 Tectonic 攻击中约 1.112 亿美元的损失。约九小时后恢复出块，但已转出网络的 919 万美元仍未被追回。

此次干预推翻了区块链的最终确定性——即交易一经确认便不可篡改的常规保证，影响了回滚窗口期内所有合法交易。它为验证者应对大型 DeFi 攻击开创了重要先例，也可能影响用户对 Cronos 及 Crypto.com 相关体系的信任。

攻击者先在流动性较低的去中心化交易市场推高 TONIC 价格，随后以被高估的抵押品在九个市场借入约 1.204 亿美元。在 1 小时 54 分钟的窗口内，所有交易都被回滚，包括无关活动；交易恢复后，活跃应用上的未平仓头寸被重新定价。
summary.en:
Validators on Cronos halted the network and rolled back 10,961 blocks, discarding 1 hour 54 minutes of transactions to reverse roughly $111.2 million taken in the Tectonic exploit. Block production resumed after about nine hours, but $9.19 million that had already left the network remains unrecovered.

The intervention overrides blockchain finality—the usual guarantee that confirmed transactions are permanent—affecting every legitimate transaction made during the rollback window. It sets a notable precedent for how validators might respond to large DeFi exploits and could shape user trust in Cronos and Crypto.com-affiliated systems.

The attacker inflated TONIC's price on low-liquidity decentralized exchange markets, then borrowed approximately $120.4 million across nine markets against the inflated collateral. Every transaction in the 1-hour-54-minute window was reversed, including unrelated activity, and open positions on live apps were repriced when trading resumed.

title.zh: 以太坊定2029年12月为量子抗性截止期限
title.en: Ethereum sets December 2029 deadline for quantum resistance

summary.zh:
9月7日，以太坊基金会Protocol集群表示，2029年12月实现量子抗性的截止日期不可妥协，这一决定将重塑后续升级。Glamsterdam之后的下一次升级Hegotá将优先保障FOCIL与Frame Transactions（EIP-8141）这两项核心内容。

这标志着以太坊路线图的一项重大决策：它不再等待量子威胁更加明朗，而是围绕一个固定且紧迫的安全期限来规划。这一转变将使抗量子工作优先于可选功能，并可能决定未来几年哪些以太坊硬分叉能进入日程。

开发者正在权衡将后量子认证（post-quantum attestations）从L*升级提前至K*，同时把强制执行证明推迟至L*，即以zkEVM时间线的延后来换取更快的抗量子加固，但该交换尚未获批。若要赶在2029年12月前全面就绪，平均约每7.2个月就要有一次硬分叉，基金会称这一节奏十分激进；若节奏延误，J*的“最低可行后量子里程碑”（MV-PQ）即为后备方案。
summary.en:
On Sept. 7, the Ethereum Foundation's Protocol cluster said the December 2029 quantum-resistance deadline is non-negotiable, reshaping upcoming upgrades. The next post-Glamsterdam upgrade, Hegotá, will protect two headliners, FOCIL and Frame Transactions (EIP-8141), for the post-quantum roadmap.

This marks a major protocol-roadmap decision: Ethereum is planning from a fixed and aggressive security deadline rather than waiting for more certainty about a quantum threat. That shift prioritizes post-quantum engineering over optional features and could determine which Ethereum hard forks make the cut in the coming years.

Developers are weighing moving post-quantum attestations forward from the L* upgrade to K*, while pushing mandatory execution proofs back to L*, trading zkEVM timeline progress for faster quantum hardening, although the swap has not been approved. Reaching full readiness by December 2029 would require hard forks roughly every 7.2 months on average, a cadence the Foundation calls aggressive; a minimum viable post-quantum milestone, MV-PQ, at J* is the fallback if that cadence slips.

title.zh: Liquid Network遭比特币黑客攻击被盗3.2亿美元
title.en: Liquid Network Bitcoin Hack Drains $320 Million

summary.zh:
多个加密货币交易所用于转移比特币的结算层Liquid Network遭到黑客攻击，被盗3.2亿美元。据报道，该网络在2026年9月7日前后遭到攻击后已暂停所有交易。

这是近期一系列重大安全事件中最新的一起，动摇了人们对数字资产安全的信心，也暴露出交易所依赖的结算基础设施所面临的风险。该事件可能促使业界更严格地审视侧链安全，并影响人们对交易所相关比特币托管和转账方式的信任。

Liquid Network是一条比特币侧链，旨在让交易所之间进行更快、更保密的转账。CoinDesk报道称，黑客提出了附带条件的提议，并自称“好人”。
summary.en:
The Liquid Network, a blockchain settlement layer used by several cryptocurrency exchanges to move Bitcoin, was hacked for $320 million. The network halted all transactions after the exploit, which was reported around September 7, 2026.

This is one of the latest major breaches to shake confidence in digital-asset security, and it exposes risks in the settlement infrastructure exchanges depend on. The incident may lead to stricter scrutiny of sidechain security and affect trust in exchange-related Bitcoin custody and transfer methods.

Liquid Network is a Bitcoin sidechain designed to allow faster and more confidential transfers between exchanges. CoinDesk reported that the hacker made a conditional offer, with the attackers claiming they were 'the good guys.'

title.zh: Tether 支持的智利交易所 Orionx 在 700 万美元客户资产流失后冻结提款
title.en: Tether-backed Chilean exchange Orionx freezes withdrawals after $7M custody loss

summary.zh:
智利加密货币交易所 Orionx 已启动永久关停并冻结客户提款，此前法务审计发现超过 700 万美元的客户资产被转至其控制之外的第三方钱包。此次倒闭发生在 Tether 于 2025 年 6 月投资 Orionx 后不到一年，此前其关联交易所 Bitfinex 已于 2023 年投资过 Orionx。

这一事件凸显了加密市场中用户保护机制依然脆弱，尤其是当 Tether 这样知名的稳定币发行方投资了某家交易所时。由于智利金融市场监管局（CMF）表示无法强制 Orionx 返还资产，受影响用户的追偿前景并不确定，这一事件也可能进一步削弱市场对托管交易所及其支持方的信任。

智利金融市场监管局（CMF）于 6 月 19 日否决了 Orionx 的注册与授权申请，结束了此前允许其在审查期间继续运营的过渡性安排。此次倒闭令超过 10 万名注册用户陷入不确定状态；Orionx 已通知检察机关，并对前高管提起刑事诉讼，但其关停进度仍停留在五个阶段中的第一阶段，余额核对与资产返还计划的批准都还未完成。
summary.en:
Chilean crypto exchange Orionx has begun a permanent shutdown and frozen customer withdrawals after a forensic audit found that more than $7 million in customer assets were moved to wallets outside its control. The collapse comes less than a year after Tether invested in Orionx in June 2025, following an earlier investment by affiliated exchange Bitfinex in 2023.

This event highlights how fragile user protections remain in crypto markets, especially where a prominent stablecoin issuer like Tether has backed an exchange. Affected users face uncertain recovery because Chile's CMF says it cannot compel Orionx to repay assets, and the situation may further undermine confidence in custodial exchanges and their backers.

Chile's CMF rejected Orionx's registration and authorization application on June 19, ending the transitional arrangement that had allowed it to operate while the application was reviewed. The failure leaves more than 100,000 registered users in limbo; Orionx has notified prosecutors and filed a criminal complaint against former executives, but its closure tracker remains at the first of five stages, with balance reconciliation and approval of a restitution plan still required.

title.zh: 22岁加密货币主谋对2.45亿美元敲诈勒索计划认罪
title.en: 22-Year-Old Crypto Ringleader Pleads Guilty to $245M Racketeering Scheme

summary.zh:
22岁主谋Malone Lam承认领导了一项国际社会工程学攻击计划，该计划窃取了约2.45亿美元的加密货币。这一认罪标志着这起备受关注的加密货币犯罪案件取得重大突破。

此案凸显出针对加密货币持有者的社会工程攻击规模与复杂程度不断上升，也表明执法部门越来越多地以敲诈勒索罪名起诉数字资产犯罪分子。案件结果可能促使行业加强安全审查，并推动形成更严格的监管与法律先例。

Lam领导了一项国际行动，利用冒充身份和接管账户等社会工程手段获取受害者的加密货币钱包。2.45亿美元的涉案金额使此案成为规模最大的加密盗窃诉讼之一，相关指控也反映了该计划具有组织化和串谋性质。
summary.en:
Malone Lam, a 22-year-old ringleader, pleaded guilty to heading an international social engineering scheme that stole approximately $245 million in cryptocurrency. The guilty plea marks a major breakthrough in the high-profile crypto crime case.

This case underscores the growing scale and sophistication of social engineering attacks targeting cryptocurrency holders, and it demonstrates how law enforcement is using racketeering charges to pursue digital-asset criminals. The outcome could heighten scrutiny on security practices and contribute to stricter regulatory and legal precedents across the crypto industry.

Lam led an international operation that used social engineering tactics such as impersonation and account takeovers to gain access to victims' cryptocurrency wallets. The $245 million figure places the case among the largest crypto theft prosecutions, and the charges reflect the organized, conspiracy-based nature of the scheme.

title.zh: OpenAI 宣称 AI 模型解决纳维-斯托克斯千禧难题
title.en: OpenAI Claims AI-Generated Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Solution

summary.zh:
OpenAI 宣布了一个据称由内部 AI 系统生成的纳维-斯托克斯存在性与光滑性问题的解答，该问题是克雷数学研究所列出的千禧年大奖难题之一。这项结果声称，描述流体运动的纳维-斯托克斯方程可以在有限时间内形成奇点。

这一宣布是对“AI 系统能否在困扰数学家数十年的著名开放问题上取得原创进展”的一次高关注度检验。如果证明成立，它可能改变外界对 AI 驱动数学研究的预期，并推动形成新的验证、同行评审和早期成果分享规范。

这项结果尚未经过独立验证或同行评审，消息公布不久后已被拿来与此前其他有争议的 AI 数学研究相比较。社区讨论还提出了溯源质疑——包括认为该工作可能建立在另一位研究者未发表成果及其提示词之上——并提到所涉及模型训练时间极短。
summary.en:
OpenAI announced a purported solution to the Navier–Stokes existence and smoothness problem, one of the Clay Mathematics Institute’s Millennium Prize Problems, claiming the proof was produced by an internal AI system. The result asserts that the governing fluid equations can develop a singularity in finite time.

This announcement is a high-profile test of whether an AI system can make original progress on a famous open problem that has resisted mathematicians for decades. If the proof holds up, it could reshape expectations about AI-driven mathematical research and force new norms for verification, peer review, and early sharing of scientific work.

The claimed proof has not been independently verified or peer-reviewed, and the announcement is already being compared to previous disputed AI-generated mathematics. Community discussion also flags questions about provenance — including allegations that the work builds on another researcher’s unpublished findings — and notes the extremely short training timeline of the model involved.

title.zh: 谷歌DeepMind发布AlphaGenome Atlas：绘制人类DNA所有可能字母变化的AI预测图谱
title.en: AlphaGenome Atlas: AI predictive map of every possible human DNA letter change

summary.zh:
谷歌DeepMind推出AlphaGenome Atlas，这是一个AI驱动的预测图谱，覆盖人类基因组中每一种可能的单碱基DNA变化。该可检索数据库收录了约90亿个单核苷酸变异（SNV）的分子效应预测和AVI评分，涵盖编码区与非编码区。

与疾病相关的变异大多位于占人类基因组98%的非编码区，而以往工具难以大规模解读这些区域。AlphaGenome Atlas将相关预测转化为可公开检索的资源，有望加速罕见病诊断、变异优先级排序和药物靶点发现。

底层的AlphaGenome模型可输入长达1Mb（约100万碱基）的侧翼DNA序列，从而避免了此前工具在上下文长度与预测分辨率之间的取舍。Atlas收录了约90亿个单核苷酸变异，用户无需填写机构信息即可免费在线访问。
summary.en:
Google DeepMind has introduced AlphaGenome Atlas, an AI-powered predictive map of every possible single-letter change in the human genome. The searchable catalogue contains molecular-effect predictions and AVI scores for roughly 9 billion single-nucleotide variants across coding and non-coding regions.

Most disease-associated variants lie in the non-coding 98% of the human genome, which previous tools struggled to interpret at scale. AlphaGenome Atlas turns those predictions into a searchable public resource that could accelerate rare-disease diagnosis, variant prioritisation and drug target discovery.

The underlying AlphaGenome model takes up to 1 megabase of surrounding DNA as input, avoiding the usual trade-off between sequence context length and prediction resolution. The Atlas covers around 9 billion single-nucleotide variants and is freely accessible online without requiring an institutional affiliation.

title.zh: 股市休市期间代币化股票周末交易额达10亿美元
title.en: Tokenized Equities Trade $1 Billion Over Weekend While Stock Market Shut

summary.zh:
42只最大的代币化股票在周六和周日合计产生了10.1亿美元的交易量，大致相当于一个典型周五的交易量，劳动节当天又增加了3.983亿美元。其中Robinhood Chain处理了周末总额中的5.728亿美元。

这一里程碑凸显了市场对7x24小时交易的日益增长需求，并表明区块链基础设施能够承载可观的传统股票类资产交易量。它标志着传统金融与加密基础设施之间的融合正在加速，可能吸引更多机构和零售用户进入代币化市场。

仅BNB Chain上一只代币化的纳斯达克100基金，就在周末交易量中贡献了1.805亿美元。Robinhood Chain是一个基于Arbitrum Orbit技术栈构建的兼容以太坊的Layer-2网络，处理了周末交易量的半数以上。
summary.en:
The 42 largest tokenized equities generated $1.01 billion in combined trading volume on Saturday and Sunday, roughly matching a typical Friday session, with an additional $398.3 million on Labor Day. Robinhood Chain processed $572.8 million of that weekend total.

This milestone underscores the growing demand for 24/7 trading and shows that blockchain rails can handle meaningful volumes of traditional stock-like assets. It signals accelerating convergence between traditional finance and crypto infrastructure, potentially drawing more institutions and retail users into tokenized markets.

A single tokenized Nasdaq-100 fund on BNB Chain accounted for $180.5 million of the weekend volume by itself. Robinhood Chain, an Ethereum-compatible Layer-2 built on the Arbitrum Orbit stack, handled more than half of the weekend trading.

title.zh: Bybit为加密货币衍生品账户新增24/7外汇交易
title.en: Bybit Adds 24/7 FX Majors to Crypto Derivatives Account

summary.zh:
Bybit已将其加密货币衍生品账户扩展至支持主要外汇对的24/7全天候交易，使用户可以在同一账户中交易传统货币与数字资产。该消息由TradingView报道。

此举将传统外汇与加密货币衍生品连接起来，使交易者无需离开加密原生平台即可获得多元化敞口。它反映了加密货币交易所正在整合传统资产以吸引机构和散户流动性的大趋势。

Bybit的外汇产品包括EUR/USD、GBP/USD、USD/JPY、AUD/USD和USD/CAD等主要货币对，可通过衍生品账户进行交易。该平台还通过MetaTrader 5提供货币、金属、指数和股票的差价合约交易，并具有竞争力的费用和24/7客户支持。
summary.en:
Bybit has expanded its crypto derivatives account to include 24/7 trading of major FX pairs, allowing users to trade traditional currencies alongside digital assets. The announcement was reported by TradingView.

This move bridges traditional forex and crypto derivatives, giving traders diversified exposure without leaving a crypto-native platform. It reflects a wider trend where crypto exchanges are integrating traditional assets to attract institutional and retail liquidity.

Bybit's FX offering includes majors such as EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY, AUD/USD, and USD/CAD, accessible within the derivatives account. The platform also supports CFD trading on currencies, metals, indices, and stocks via MetaTrader 5, with competitive fees and 24/7 customer support.

title.zh: Robinhood入股Crypto.com与OG.com，扩展预测市场业务
title.en: Robinhood takes minority stakes in Crypto.com, OG.com in prediction-markets deal

summary.zh:
Robinhood宣布与OG.com达成多年期协议，将其预测市场事件合约（event contracts）路由至OG.com受美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）监管的衍生品交易所和清算所结算。作为安排的一部分，Robinhood同时获得Crypto.com和OG.com的少数股权，该服务已于周二向符合条件的美国用户开始推出。

这笔交易将美国主流零售券商与Crypto.com生态及受CFTC监管的事件合约基础设施连接起来，使预测市场获得更深的机构背书。它也凸显了Robinhood预测市场业务的快速增长——第二季度事件合约收入已超过股票和加密货币交易收入。

Robinhood所持股权按Citadel Securities此前对相关平台投资时确定的估值定价，但未披露持股规模和价值。OG.com刚从Crypto.com以50亿美元估值分拆，并计划在预测市场之外扩展至期货和永续合约（perpetual contracts）业务。
summary.en:
Robinhood announced a multi-year deal with OG.com to route its prediction-market event contracts through OG.com's CFTC-regulated derivatives exchange and clearinghouse. As part of the arrangement, Robinhood received minority equity stakes in both Crypto.com and OG.com, with the rollout beginning Tuesday for eligible US customers.

The deal links a major US retail brokerage with Crypto.com's ecosystem and CFTC-regulated event-contract infrastructure, giving prediction markets deeper institutional backing. It also underscores how quickly Robinhood's prediction-markets business has grown, with event contracts overtaking equities and crypto transaction revenue in the second quarter.

Robinhood's stakes are priced at valuations set by an earlier Citadel Securities investment in the platforms, though the size and value of the holdings were not disclosed. OG.com was recently spun off from Crypto.com at a $5 billion valuation and plans to expand beyond prediction markets into futures and perpetual contracts.

title.zh: Visa将VisaNet数据接入链上借贷以支持稳定币卡业务
title.en: Visa Ties VisaNet Data to Onchain Lending for Stablecoin Cards

summary.zh:
Visa于周二宣布，将VisaNet结算数据与基于区块链的借贷基础设施结合，使贷款方可以利用交易记录为与稳定币挂钩的卡项目的营运资金需求提供融资。Visa将Credit Coop列为早期案例；该协议自2023年以来已累计融资超过25亿美元的结算量。

此举将链上信贷与主流卡支付结算连接起来，标志着机构采用的重要一步，使去中心化借贷实际扩展到加密原生市场之外。若进展顺利，可为金融科技公司和卡项目更便捷地提供营运资金，并增强稳定币在现实商业中的地位。

Visa表示，其网络上的稳定币结算量已超过200亿美元的年化运行率，是去年同期的15倍以上；在160多个卡项目中，与稳定币相关的支付量同比上涨近200%。Visa还援引其分析面板称，自2020年以来，链上借贷协议已处理超过6940亿美元的稳定币贷款。
summary.en:
Visa announced on Tuesday it is combining VisaNet settlement data with blockchain-based lending infrastructure, allowing lenders to use transaction records to finance stablecoin-linked card programs' working capital needs. Visa cited Credit Coop, which has financed over $2.5 billion in settlement volume since 2023, as an early example.

The initiative marks a significant step in institutional adoption by linking onchain credit with mainstream card payment settlement, effectively expanding decentralized lending beyond crypto-native markets. If successful, it could give fintechs and card programs easier access to working capital and deepen stablecoin's role in real-world commerce.

Visa reported that stablecoin settlement volume through its network has surpassed a $20 billion annualized run rate, more than 15 times year-ago levels, and that stablecoin-linked payment volume is up nearly 200% year over year across over 160 card programs. The company also noted that onchain lending protocols have processed more than $694 billion in stablecoin loans since 2020, citing Visa's analytics dashboard.

title.zh: 白宫调整对加拿大汽车加征关税的产品范围
title.en: White House Modifies Scope of Tariffs on Canadian Motor Vehicles

summary.zh:
白宫发布公告，修改了根据2026年7月20日第11048号公告对加拿大产品加征额外关税的适用范围。这些关税旨在应对美方认定的加拿大对美国汽车实施的歧视性关税。

该行动延续了美国对加拿大汽车贸易做法的制裁措施，将影响供应链跨境的美加汽车制造商和零部件供应商。这也表明华盛顿愿意继续利用《关税法》第338条作为双边贸易争端中的施压工具。

该公告依据1930年《关税法》第338条（19 U.S.C. 1338）。第11048号公告认定，加拿大通过《2025年美国汽车附加税令》(SOR/2025-118) 仅对美国汽车征收关税，而给予其他国家更优惠的待遇。新公告进一步调整了受影响的加拿大产品清单。
summary.en:
The White House has issued a proclamation modifying the scope of Canadian products subject to additional duties first imposed under Proclamation 11048 of July 20, 2026. The duties were adopted to counter what the US determined to be Canada's discriminatory tariffs on US motor vehicles.

This action continues US enforcement against Canadian automotive trade practices and will affect automakers and parts suppliers whose supply chains cross the border. It also signals that Washington is willing to keep using Section 338 of the Tariff Act as leverage in bilateral trade disputes.

The proclamation operates under Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 (19 U.S.C. 1338). Proclamation 11048 had found that Canada's United States Surtax Order (Motor Vehicles 2025), SOR/2025-118, imposed tariffs only on US motor vehicles while treating other countries more favorably. The new proclamation refines the list of affected Canadian products.

title.zh: OpenAI宣称破解纳维-斯托克斯问题，对手数学家质疑成果归属
title.en: OpenAI Claims Navier-Stokes Breakthrough; Rival Mathematician Disputes Credit

summary.zh:
OpenAI宣布，其内部AI模型以约一万个智能体协同工作88小时，生成了一个经过Lean验证的证明，表明纳维-斯托克斯流体方程可以发生爆破。就在数小时前，纽约大学数学家Tristan Buckmaster指责OpenAI试图为他与Anthropic研究员Levent Alpöge已完成的成果抢占优先权。

纳维-斯托克斯问题是克莱数学研究所七个千禧年大奖难题之一，每个奖金为100万美元，因此经过验证的爆破证明将是数学领域的里程碑，也是AI在形式推理方面的惊人展示。优先权之争还引发了对科研伦理以及AI实验室在激烈竞争环境中如何处理未发表工作的重要拷问。

Buckmaster声称，他在9月将未发表证明的细节告知了一位OpenAI数学家，此后OpenAI的Sébastien Bubeck先提出协调发表，但随后又施压，并提到OpenAI内部已完成一份100页的强制纳维-斯托克斯爆破证明。OpenAI、Bubeck和Sam Altman均否认指控，Bubeck还公开了短信记录，称这些消息表明他曾真诚提议进行协调发布。
summary.en:
OpenAI announced that its internal AI models, coordinated as roughly 10,000 agents over 88 hours, produced a Lean-verified proof that the Navier-Stokes fluid equations can blow up. Hours earlier, NYU mathematician Tristan Buckmaster accused OpenAI of trying to claim priority for work he and Anthropic's Levent Alpöge had already completed.

The Navier-Stokes problem is one of the Clay Mathematics Institute's seven Millennium Prize Problems, each worth $1 million, so a verified blow-up proof would be a landmark in mathematics and a striking demonstration of AI in formal reasoning. The priority dispute also raises important questions about research ethics and how AI labs handle unpublished work in a competitive research environment.

Buckmaster stated that he shared details of his unpublished proof with an OpenAI mathematician in September, after which OpenAI's Sébastien Bubeck allegedly offered to coordinate publication but then pressured him, mentioning an internal 100-page proof of forced Navier-Stokes blow-up. OpenAI, Bubeck, and Sam Altman deny the allegations, and Bubeck published text messages that he says demonstrate good-faith offers for a coordinated release.
